question: How large is the moving-pulse linear initial-housing-phase to non-affine output gain over original u=100; does the post-selected phase match finite nonlinear difference?

objects.definition: q280,v280, full rigid kinetic modes retained

assumptions: Unchanged positive reciprocal 560-state 3D surrogate, continuous dimensionless u, uncalibrated physical units
One deterministic scattered ±5% primary ±1% gains ±10% housings case, beta=.005 cf=0 nu=.05
Initial heart alpha=0.1 primary/device reference/rest, varying housing phase 180D
Tangent is first-order around the moving pulse, and finite selected ±phase checks do not certify other phases

target_exposure.status: previous threshold and original u100 pulse exposed; case/phase/time selected for development
target_exposure.parameter_search: 1 deterministic case, 401 coarse + 601 locally refined sample points, 180-phase singular vectors; 1 chosen ±phase finite pair
target_exposure.model_selection: No fitting to experimental data; nu and tolerances inherited

calculation_steps: Construct analytic JVP for all radial/edge strains, port forces, mount/strut geometry and viscous coordinate derivatives
Directional finite-difference JVP checks at moving and displaced states
DOP853 evolve full560 nonlinear reference plus 560x180 tangent
Project to rank24 shell subspace and compute worst singular value at each sampled time
Select maximum sampled time/phase and simulate actual nonlinear ±phase; compare central derivative and conservation

result.scope: One coefficient set, all 180 *linear initial-phase directions* at sampled times; no nonlinear allphase u100, parameter box or continuous time bound

verification.method: same-runtime JVP vs central finite differences

counterexamples_and_failures: Static exact one-shell-vertex displacement defeats energy-only ||Z||<=1/40 as full nonlinear universal claim
No validated second nonlinear derivative/forced Green, reference defect or allphase nonlinear flow bound; PR44 separate held claim
next_discriminant: Validated projected moving-pulse nonlinear flow remainder for all housing phases and continuous qualified property box with time-continuous margins.
